purpose: Prepare one auditable root-run installer that, only when explicitly executed later, publishes the already-tested metadata-only SC001 inventory and adds only that published directory as a Reader root. Do not execute or deploy it in this task.
implementation_requirements: Require an explicit --apply flag for real host mutation; default invocation must not mutate.
Provide a --self-test using only temporary synthetic directories/config and never reference the real source root.
On --apply require effective uid 0 and exact exporter SHA256 match.
Never expose /home/botmarket/sc001_data itself as a Reader root.
Run the frozen exporter only with the exact fixed source root and fixed inventory output; no arbitrary source/output CLI values.
Create/preserve the published directory with Reader-readable least privilege and make only inventory-v0.1.json readable by the Reader group.

Load reader-roots.json, require schema_version=1 and a roots object, preserve every existing root unchanged, and add sc001_historical_inventory={path: published_dir, mode: read_only}. If that name already exists with a different spec, fail closed.
Write reader-roots.json atomically while preserving its existing uid/gid/mode. No backup containing secrets/config values may be copied to GitHub.
Do not restart or mutate systemd. Reader server reloads roots config on each call, so no service restart is required.
Do not chmod/chown or otherwise modify anything inside /home/botmarket/sc001_data.
Print only bounded success/failure tokens and metadata counts; no inventory contents.
next_after_pass: Strategy Manager static-reviews and canonicalizes the installer, then the exact host-side --apply action remains a USER_GATE_REQUIRED/manual-host action because no connected tool has host config mutation authority.
